# Third-party sources

Both packs are by Quaternius and released under CC0 1.0 (`LICENSE-Quaternius-CC0.txt`).
Downloaded from itch.io on 2026-10-12.

| File | Pack | Used for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Superhero_Male_FullBody.gltf/.bin` | [Universal Base Characters](https://quaternius.itch.io/universal-base-characters) (Standard) | Anatomy and 65-bone rig under Podro. The mesh is reshaped, dressed, decimated and re-UV'd by `tools/build_podro.py`. |
| `UAL1_Standard.glb` | [Universal Animation Library](https://quaternius.itch.io/universal-animation-library) (Standard, no root motion) | Podro's clips: idle, jog, sprint, sword swing (hammer), punch, hit, death, driving, jumps, talk, pickup, interact. |

The original textures of the base character are not used; Podro's texture is `../reference/podro_texture_sheet.png`.
